children: Major central banks in the United States, Japan, and the United Kingdom are set to announce monetary policy decisions this week, with markets focused on whether the Federal Reserve will begin raising rates for the first time in three years. According to ChainCatcher, Iran and Gulf states are also holding talks on managing shipping through the Strait of Hormuz as they respond to elevated crude oil prices.

title: Markets Await Fed Decision as Major Central Banks Set Policy Meetings
